description: Master registry of external data sources evaluated in the drone-data-mining effort. Classifies each by what it is, license, whether it is bulk-mineable, where it landed (or why it didn't), and which ecosystem repo it serves. New sources get appended here.

sources.name: CNAS World of Drones
sources.notes: 153 military/gov platforms; full specs + DoD UAS Group. See cnas/.

sources.name: ERAU UAS Research Guide
sources.notes: Open resources (FAA, NCSL, ASIAS, AUVSI) usable; subscription DBs (Janes, Scopus) reference-only.

sources.name: DroneRF dataset (Al-Sa'd et al. 2019)
sources.notes: 3 consumer drones (Parrot Bebop, AR 2.0, DJI Phantom 3) across 2.4 GHz ISM. Closes the RF gap. Firmware integration pending review.

sources.name: UZH-FPV Drone Racing Dataset
sources.notes: Real FPV flights: camera + IMU + event camera + Leica ground truth, up to 100 km/h. Raw multi-GB rosbags for VIO/state-estimation R&D, not structured facts. NC license blocks commercial/product use — usable as a research benchmark only.

sources.name: Mid-Air Dataset (Fonder & Van Droogenbroeck, 2019)
sources.notes: Synthetic low-altitude drone flights: 420k frames, 3 RGB cams + depth/normals/semantics/stereo disparity + simulated IMU/GPS, across 7 climates. For VIO/SLAM/depth/semantic R&D. Synthetic + NC license -> research benchmark only, not product data. Same class as UZH-FPV.

sources.name: Seraphim Drone Detection Dataset
sources.landed: registry only — training data, not structured facts
ecosystem_use: Ai-Project (apb on-board AI / counter-UAS visual detector)
sources.notes: 83k YOLO-format images (640x640), single 'drone' class, 9.14 GB. Curated from 23 open sets; mixed real/synthetic. Permissive license -> usable to train a visual drone detector if/when one exists.

sources.name: Drone Detection Dataset (pathikg)
ecosystem_use: Ai-Project (apb on-board AI / counter-UAS visual detector)
sources.notes: 54k COCO-format images (640x480), single 'drone' class, 4.65 GB. From YouTube frames (Pawelczyk & Wojtyra). Permissive license -> trainable.

sources.name: Birds vs Drone Dataset (harshwalia)
sources.license: Kaggle — unconfirmed (not retrievable via anonymous fetch; reCAPTCHA-gated)
sources.notes: Bird-vs-drone classification — addresses the real C-UAS false-positive problem (telling birds from drones). Confirm license on Kaggle before any use. License verification attempted 2026-05-31: Kaggle dataset page is JS/reCAPTCHA-gated, license not machine-readable — confirm on the page before any use.

sources.name: Drone Dataset (toolazycoder)
sources.license: Kaggle — unconfirmed (not retrievable via anonymous fetch; reCAPTCHA-gated)
sources.notes: Generic drone-image set; details/license not confirmed via fetch. Verify on Kaggle before use. License verification attempted 2026-05-31: Kaggle dataset page is JS/reCAPTCHA-gated, license not machine-readable — confirm on the page before any use.

sources.name: LADD — Lacmus Drone Dataset
sources.notes: Search-and-rescue: detects PEOPLE (pedestrian class) from drone imagery, not drones. 1365 images, 4733 boxes, VOC/XML, DJI Mavic/Phantom at 50-100 m. Relevant only if a SAR/person-detection capability is added — no current ecosystem home.

sources.name: Tyto Robotics Propulsion Database
sources.license: Terms of Service (community-uploaded; NOT a clear open license — verify before any extraction)
sources.landed: registry only — NOT scraped; ToS checked, no reuse grant
sources.notes: STRONGEST build-planner fit since DroneRF: 1,513 propulsion systems, 364 components (120 motors, 189 propellers, 55 ESCs), 174,426 measured samples (thrust/RPM/current/voltage, g/W efficiency). Would enrich motors/propellers/escs with real measured performance + thrust curves. BLOCKERS: community-uploaded data under ToS (not open-licensed); CSV/API bulk export unconfirmed. UPDATE: their public Terms of Service is silent on data ownership/reuse/export — so reuse rights CANNOT be assumed. Blocked pending explicit written permission (info@tytorobotics.com). Do not scrape. Highest-value add IF permission is granted.

sources.name: DroneDB.com
sources.license: unknown (closed commercial site; no stated open license)
sources.landed: registry only — NOT scraped (closed SPA, no public API/terms)
sources.notes: Self-described 'most comprehensive drone database' spanning research/consumer/enterprise/military. JS-rendered SPA (no data in raw HTML), no documented public API, terms/license unknown. Scope OVERLAPS what we already hold (CNAS = 150 military; build-planner = 274 consumer/FPV) — marginal value is mostly consumer/enterprise breadth. NOT the open-source dronedb.app (geospatial tooling). Action: check for a public API + reuse terms before any extraction; do not scrape a closed aggregator otherwise.

sources.name: open-dronelog (arpanghosh8453)
sources.landed: registry only — it's a tool, ships no data
ecosystem_use: Ai-Project (Prismo GCS — same Rust+Tauri v2 stack; flight-log analysis feature reference)
sources.notes: Flight-log analysis app (desktop/web): parses DJI .txt, Litchi/Airdata CSV, Dronelink, DroneDeploy; 3D replay, battery health, maintenance tracking; export CSV/JSON/GPX/KML/PDF. Stack: Rust + Tauri v2 + React + DuckDB (mirrors Prismo). NOT a dataset and NOT mineable. AGPL-3.0 = do NOT copy code into the proprietary stack; useful only as a feature/parser-format reference and competitive study. Mineable fact = the set of log formats worth supporting.

sources.name: DroneDetectionDataset (Maciullo)
sources.notes: 51,446 train + 5,375 test 640x480 RGB, single 'drone' class, XML/Haar labels + trained Haar/ANN models, ~5GB externally hosted. ORIGINAL of the pathikg HF dataset (same Pawelczyk & Wojtyra YouTube-frame source, reformatted to COCO) -> DEDUPE, don't count twice. Permissive (MIT).

sources.name: Roboflow Universe — class:drone
sources.license: per-dataset (CC BY 4.0 common on Roboflow Universe)
sources.landed: n/a — portal of many CV datasets
sources.notes: Search index of community CV datasets carrying a 'drone' class; YOLO/COCO export + API (key required; anonymous fetch = 403). Most are CC BY 4.0. Triage each dataset's license individually before use.

sources.name: Google Dataset Search — 'drone'
sources.notes: A search index, not a dataset. Use it to FIND candidate datasets; each hit must be evaluated on its own license/format before mining. Candidates to triage on request.
